code_or_query:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.xkcd()
fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(2,1, figsize=(8,7))
# side view
ax1.set_title("Side view at midspan - recessed cassette below deck")
ax1.set_xlim(0,10); ax1.set_ylim(0,5)
# deck
ax1.fill_between([0,10],[4,4],[4.3,4.3], color='gray', alpha=0.5)
ax1.text(5,4.45,"deck walking surface (unchanged)", ha='center', fontsize=8)
# girders
ax1.fill_between([0,10],[3.3,3.3],[4.0,4.0], color='gray', alpha=0.3)
ax1.text(0.5,3.6,"girder", fontsize=8)
# parapet (deck eye height)
ax1.plot([0,10],[4.3,4.3], linewidth=2)
ax1.plot([0,0],[4.3,5.0], linewidth=2); ax1.plot([10,10],[4.3,5.0], linewidth=2)
ax1.text(9,4.7,"parapet void empty", fontsize=7)
ax1.text(5,4.9,"deck eye-height sightline - nothing visible", ha='center', fontsize=7)
# cassette
ax1.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((4,2.0),2,1.3, fill=False, linewidth=2))
ax1.text(5,2.6,"moving mass\n(free vertical)", ha='center', fontsize=7)
# springs/damper
ax1.plot([4.5,4.5],[3.3,2.0], linewidth=1.5); ax1.plot([5.5,5.5],[3.3,2.0], linewidth=1.5)
ax1.text(5,3.1,"springs+damper", ha='center', fontsize=7)
ax1.plot([4,4],[3.3,3.6], linewidth=2); ax1.plot([6,6],[3.3,3.6], linewidth=2)
ax1.text(5,3.55,"cross-beam on clamps (fixed)", ha='center', fontsize=7)
# screen
ax1.plot([3.5,6.5],[1.8,1.8], linewidth=2, linestyle='--')
ax1.text(5,1.5,"perforated soffit screen color-matched (fixed)", ha='center', fontsize=7)
ax1.set_axis_off()
# bottom view
ax2.set_title("Bottom view - between girders")
ax2.set_xlim(0,10); ax2.set_ylim(0,4)
ax2.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((1,0.5),8,3, fill=False, linewidth=1.5))
ax2.text(5,3.7,"deck soffit", ha='center', fontsize=8)
ax2.plot([2,2],[0.5,3.5], linewidth=4, alpha=0.4); ax2.plot([8,8],[0.5,3.5], linewidth=4, alpha=0.4)
ax2.text(2,0.2,"girder L (fixed)", ha='center', fontsize=7); ax2.text(8,0.2,"girder R (fixed)", ha='center', fontsize=7)
ax2.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((4,1.2),2,1.6, fill=False, linewidth=2))
ax2.text(5,2.0,"TMD mass", ha='center', fontsize=8)
ax2.plot([4,6],[2.8,2.8], linewidth=2)
ax2.text(5,3.0,"cross-beam", ha='center', fontsize=7)
ax2.text(5,1.0,"perforated screen outline", ha='center', fontsize=7)
ax2.set_axis_off()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("sketch.png")
